turnLimitScope: One ACP prompt; cancel/stop on any tool-call or client permission request. Top-level --max-turns is not forwarded to the agent branch in the inspected official source.
prompt: Review sanitized source/design summary; no tools/web/files. Desktop stores per-skill {activeRevision,versions:[{revision,digest,content,createdAt,reason}]} in a 2MB private pack journal. Apply/revert append activeRevision+1; list caps at100. Reviewed revert creates a new revision and clears dependent approvals/schedules via durable upgrade intent. Config snapshots copy overrides; present overrides win rollback, absent skills may restore old overrides. Config-history archival exists; do not redesign it. Propose separate immutable content-addressed skill batches; optional head on each override travels into config snapshots; keep newest2 including active inline. Archive changes no active bytes/revision/approval. Per-journal writer lock: preview binds installation generation, active digest/revision, exact versions/head and trusted local scope; persist small intent, write/readback/fsync private batch, atomically replace head+hot list. Same intent resumes after crash/lost reply; conflicts hold without pruning. Bounded pages pin selected root; revert binds target digest plus active revision/digest and uses existing approval-clearing path. Backups collect skill heads reachable from current config and recent/archived config snapshots; shared references legal, cycles/missing/detached/foreign/tampered batches reject. Old journals/backups without heads remain valid. Restore preserves text/history but no approval/schedule authority; archive pending blocks backup. Batch size/count and global2MB budget stay bounded; proposal receipts never silently pruned. Assess minimal compatible design; no secrets/customer data. Return top3 hidden failure interleavings/tests, ranked, especially reintroduced skills/revision ABA, journal full before intent, shared backup graph/crash durability. JSON only {"cases":[{"title":"...","setup":"...","assertions":["..."]}]} exactly3 cases max4 assertions each under280 words. Advice only, not tests/approval.
authentication: Existing cached auth via opaque symlink in disposable private GROK_HOME; harness never opens auth contents.

cases.title: 1. Reintroduced-skill revision ABA
cases.setup: Revert binds G1, rev 4, Da, and Ha, then crashes. Absent rollback restores Ha and the hot window reuses rev 4. Apply then writes Db with approvals intact. Resume matches 4/Da or treats Db as done.
assertions: Recheck generation, scope, revision, digest, hot versions, and head; hold on mismatch.
Apply or restore reaching Db must not complete revert or skip approval clearing.
New epoch must stop hot-window reuse of an old revision-digest pair.
Present overrides beat snapshot heads; missing head must not match Ha.

cases.title: 2. Journal full before intent
cases.setup: Journal is at 2MB with newest-two, receipts, and holds. Apply drops a receipt or archives history to fit the intent, then crashes before fsync, no batch written. Retry sees unchanged active bytes and revision while archive-pending blocks backup.
assertions: No archive, prune, or batch write until intent fsync succeeds.
Do not delete receipts or holds to free the intent slot; an unrecorded conflict must not proceed.
Mid-compaction crash restores prior bytes, revision, approvals, and content.
Retry keeps a single receipt and must not block backup.

cases.title: 3. Shared-graph crash durability
cases.setup: Current and archived config share B. Durable intent, B2 fsynced, crash before head and hot-list replace. Backup scans both roots during resume. Roots are acyclic; their union cycles. Resume then commits and clears approvals.
assertions: One point-in-time cut: no new head with a missing batch or torn hot list.
Allow diamonds; reject merged cycles, foreign, detached, missing, or tampered batches.
After commit, replay must not bump revision or clear later approvals.
No-head legacy journals restore text only, with no approval or schedule authority.
